question: Should `pluginSecretRefSetup` be accepted as a stable public plugin-SDK contract for plugin-owned SecretRef setup commands, or should this abstraction remain internal until its broader API shape is decided?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the public SDK baseline; only maintainers can decide whether that compatibility commitment is appropriate beyond the two current bundled plugins.

options.title: Approve the public SDK contract
options.body: Accept the shared setup-plan API as a supported plugin SDK surface, then remove the release-owned changelog entry and complete normal merge checks.

options.title: Keep the helper internal for now
options.body: Refactor the shared helper behind an internal core seam or retain owner-local setup code until maintainers define the plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the public SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept the shared setup-plan API as a supported plugin SDK surface, then remove the release-owned changelog entry and complete normal merge checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the recent hardening and dependency review context for this exact contract and are the strongest available routing candidate.
